answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a unique physical beacon whose timing jitter is calibrated against a quartz oscillator, making cheap mass registration physically detectable. Sybil resistance then follows a fable of provable personhood: every new agent must be vouched for by a distinct sparrow-tagged hardware token, so colluders cannot reuse one device across. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
